title: KikisApp Manifest
description: Discovery manifest served at /.well-known/kikis-app.json on every KikisApp provider endpoint

min_client_version.description: Minimum SDK client version (major.minor) required to use this manifest. Clients below this version must refuse to pay.

deprecated_modes.description: Payment modes still listed in 'modes' for backwards compatibility but deprecated for new integrations.

sunset_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which this manifest version is no longer supported by the provider.

description.description: Human-readable description of the provider's data or service

modes.description: Payment modes supported by this provider

network.description: Stellar network this provider operates on

asset_contract.description: Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) address for the payment asset. Optional for native XLM, where it may be omitted or set to 'native'.

assets.description: Payment assets accepted by this provider. Each asset can be scoped to specific modes and endpoints. When present, assets[0] must match the root-level asset and asset_contract.

pricing.description: Pricing configuration per supported payment mode

mpp-session-ws.description: WebSocket transport variant of mpp-session: channel opened and first voucher negotiated over HTTP, then the connection upgrades to WebSocket for push-based streaming.

endpoints.description: Map of endpoint name to endpoint descriptors

tags.description: Capability tags indexed with trigram search in the provider registry

nulth_account.description: Optional Nulth smart account address associated with this provider

capabilities.description: Optional protocol features this provider supports

regions.description: IATA airport codes or UN/LOCODE identifiers for regions where this provider has infrastructure (e.g. ['IAD', 'AMS']). Used by agents to select the nearest provider.

latency_hints.description: Provider-declared p50 latency in milliseconds per region code. Keys must be a subset of 'regions'. Example: { 'IAD': 14, 'AMS': 22 }.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature (payee keypair) over the SHA-256 hash of this manifest with the signature field omitted. Clients must verify before trusting any routing field.

signature_version.description: Manifest signature format. Version 2 recursively includes every nested manifest field in the signed digest.

categories.description: Optional hierarchical categories from a published taxonomy (e.g. data/price/crypto)

asset_contract.description: Optional for native XLM: may be omitted or set to 'native'.
Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) address for the payment asset

VaultMode.description: Agent vault / custody mode for payments from this provider

AssetConfig.description: Payment asset configuration with optional mode and endpoint scoping

asset_contract.description: Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) address for the payment asset. Optional for native XLM, where it may be omitted or set to 'native'.

modes.description: Optional: restrict this asset to specific payment modes. If omitted, available for all modes.

endpoints.description: Optional: restrict this asset to specific endpoints. If omitted, available for all endpoints.

asset_contract.description: Optional for native XLM: may be omitted or set to 'native'.
